company.name: Wheel
company.shortDescription: wheel is a healthcare technology company that provides virtual care for patients.
company.description:
Wheel is a healthcare technology company that brings together the tech infrastructure and clinicians to power virtual care and telehealth. It provides companies and clinicians with everything they need to deliver care virtually. Today, Wheel powers virtual-first care for the most forward-thinking organizations in healthcare — including digital health companies, clinical lab networks, retailers, and tech companies.

Wheel was founded in January 2018 by Michelle Davey and Griffin Mulcahey.

aiResearchSummary.text: Wheel is focused on enhancing virtual care through innovative middleware computing platforms. Their R&D efforts include maintaining an active user pool and developing interfaces for user-to-user service platforms. These advancements aim to streamline scheduling and service requests, facilitating efficient interactions between users of different computing platforms. This approach underscores Wheel's commitment to improving the accessibility and quality of virtual healthcare services.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $150,000,000, or 69.57% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,394,583 to $1,235,047,422, a 167.02x increase.
